purpose: Design a unified registry-fed shell that routes Tiny Goblin Academy visual assets into the appropriate preview or planning mode without building the tool suite, approving runtime use, or replacing the preserved prototypes.
designPrinciples: Every asset view must show pipelineUse, reviewStatus, and runtimeEligibility.
Denied, deferred, future-pantry-only, historical, and needs-human-review status must be visible.
Tools may produce draft planning JSON, but not runtime approval.
Single-file/offline ergonomics are useful, but canonical tools should be registry-fed.
No tool should mutate source assets directly.
Prototype code is reference material, not canonical implementation.

toolModes.primaryQuestion: Which goblin bench should this asset go to?
toolModes.purpose: List pantry entries, group by game/domain/tool target, show readiness and runtime boundaries, and route selected manifests to the correct viewer mode.
inputs: manifest records referenced by pantry entries

toolModes.purpose: Preview animation manifests and state/pose sequences with frame stepping, playback, FPS controls, and status boundaries.

toolModes.primaryQuestion: What is the box around this asset?
toolModes.purpose: Inspect sourceRects, derivedRects, cleanup status, labels, categories, risk notes, exclusions, and manifest status for region/cleanup assets.

toolModes.primaryQuestion: Where does this asset or entity go in the scene?
toolModes.purpose: Load a background/scene-anchor surface plus selectable assets and allow draft layout composition with planning JSON export only.
inputs: placement grammar or layout composition manifests when present

toolModes.primaryQuestion: What visual effect can we conjure?
toolModes.purpose: Preview particle presets and adjustable procedural FX as the future replacement lane for many glow/fire/smoke/portal sprite cleanup risks.
Reserve a Tier 2.5 audio pipeline surface for future sound preview, license metadata, normalization metadata, and runtime trigger planning.

shellCapabilities: list asset groups from the pantry index
open a manifest in the appropriate mode
show source, derived, evidence, and prototype-reference paths
show warnings and runtime boundaries before viewer launch
route animation manifests to Flipbook Viewer
route region and cleanup manifests to Region Asset Browser
route scene-anchor/background manifests to Scene Composition Layout Editor
route particle preset manifests to Particle FX Viewer later
show future audio placeholder without implementing audio

recommendedRouteRules.when: operationalType includes character-animation-sheet, enemy-animation-sheet, pet-animation-sheet, or manifest contains animations
manifest contains regions or cleanup candidate regions
operationalType is scene-anchor-background or manifest contains anchors
manifest is particle preset or fx planning manifest
manifest is future audio inventory or sound manifest

discoveryLaw: Do not scan random folders as the first source of truth.
Load source/derived/evidence image paths only after manifest status is known.
Display review/runtime status before showing export or planning actions.

supports: palette of selectable assets from pantry/manifest

prototypeFeatureSources.boundary: Evidence prototypes only; not registry-fed canonical tools.
Reference prototype only; future version must load manifests and preserve runtime boundaries.
Reference prototype only; future version must load backgrounds, anchors, and assets from registries.
Reference prototype only; no runtime FX behavior approval.

safetyBoundaries: H5.88B designs the unified shell only.
No PNGs or images are changed.
No package or lock files are changed.
No manifests or docs folders are reorganized.
Prototype files remain preserved references, not canonical tools.
Scene Composition mode outputs draft layout JSON only; runtime placement remains unapproved.

firstImplementationRecommendation.recommendedLane: H5.88C — GlyphForge Viewer Shell Static Prototype Plan
firstImplementationRecommendation.recommendedFirstToolModeIfImplementation: Region Asset Browser / Sticker Picture Book Mode
firstImplementationRecommendation.reason: Region Asset Browser can immediately browse the visual pantry, cleanup outputs, denied/deferred regions, and game asset sheets before runtime wiring starts. It also benefits most directly from the Sprite Box Annotator prototype while staying safely planning/review-only.

nonGoals: Do not build the tool suite.
Do not convert prototypes into canonical implementations.
openQuestions: Should H5.88C plan a static shell prototype before any implementation?
Should Region Asset Browser be the first implemented mode because it supports immediate pantry review?
Should the shell be single-file/offline HTML first, or a repo app surface later?
Should draft layout JSON from Scene Composition use board pixels, anchor-relative hints, or both?
Should the shell consume the pantry index directly or consume a generated tool-focused registry derived from the pantry index?
Where should canonical tool implementation live after prototypes: tools/glyphforge/viewer-shell, an app route, or generated static evidence tooling?
notes: Sprite Box Annotator asks what is this asset.
Sticker Book Editor asks where does it go.
Flipbook asks how does it move.
Particle Viewer asks what effect can we conjure.
GlyphForge shell asks which goblin bench gets the asset.
